ValidationRule.description: If you choose acquired as the subreason, please fill in acquisition info
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.ValidationSetting__c.ByPassAllValidationRules__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "SWAT", ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c , "Acquired"), ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Subreason__c), ISBLANK ( Acquisition_Info__c ) )
